caption: The drawing depicts two round, metal objects, arranged so that one is set at an angle behind the other. The larger object is an upright, circular disk with a slightly textured and worn surface; it is rimmed, and evenly spaced radial lines extend from a central raised circle, giving it a sun-like pattern. The other object, oriented horizontally in front, has a flat, shallow, circular form with a smooth surface and a small, dome-shaped element at its center. A single thick, curved strap or handle connects the two objects, looping smoothly down and forward from the base of the larger disk to the edge of the smaller one. The drawing is rendered in shades of gray on a pale, beige background, and subtle shading conveys the metallic, reflective quality and three-dimensional aspect of the objects. At the bottom left corner, the artist has signed the work with the name "AMELIA TOCCI."
title: Sconce
